title: Unique Comforting Malaysian Fromage-Blanc Fondue
description: A comforting Malaysian dish featuring fromage-blanc, tempering chocolate, and herbal notes, served in a fondue pot. This vegetarian-friendly fondue is perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: In a fondue pot, combine softened fromage-blanc, melted tempering chocolate, coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, sliced galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
Heat the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until the fromage-blanc is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add palm sugar and stir until dissolved.
Remove the lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves from the pot.
Serve the fondue with an assortment of dippers, such as vegetables or crackers.
Drizzle with vegetable oil before serving.
Keep the fondue warm over low heat to prevent it from solidifying.
Stir the fondue occasionally to prevent scorching.
